name: acutance
text: acutance Apparent edge crispness, including haloed edge contrast. dull edges biting edge snap

name: black level

text: bokeh softness How smoothly out-of-focus areas dissolve while the focus plane stays sharp. hard nervous bokeh creamy soft bokeh

name: clarity

name: cleanup level

name: color separation

name: diffusion

name: digital oversharpening
text: digital oversharpening Haloed, crunchy edge enhancement typical of digital sharpening. no sharpening halo crunchy haloed sharpening

text: dynamic range compression compressed dynamic range print-range squeeze How much of the scene's luminance range is squeezed into the display range. expansive range heavily compressed range

name: edge softness
text: edge softness soft edges edge melt Width and melt of edges, independent of highlight glow. hard razor edges melted wide edges

name: exposure bias
text: exposure bias Overall placement of the exposure, independent of contrast shape. underexposed overexposed

name: fabric heaviness
text: fabric heaviness How heavy, coarse, or physically present cloth reads. thin digital cloth heavy physical cloth

name: field curvature feel
text: field curvature feel Focus that does not sit on a flat plane, so corners or mid-field drift. flat field strongly curved field

name: final bloom
text: final bloom A finishing glow applied in grade, not claimed as film-base halation. no finishing bloom heavy finishing bloom

name: fine-detail roll-off
text: fine-detail roll-off mtf roll-off high-frequency roll-off How quickly high spatial frequencies die, the MTF-like slope. extended fine detail early fine-detail death

name: flicker

text: focal-length feel Perspective and spatial compression associated with lens length, not just crop. wide expanded space long compressed space

name: frame cadence feel
text: frame cadence feel The stepping rhythm of motion from frame rate and pulldown. smooth high-rate cadence stepped cinematic cadence

name: frame density
text: frame density How packed the frame is with information. sparse dense

name: gamma response
text: gamma response Nonlinear tone mapping shape beyond a simple lift or contrast swing. dark receded mids lifted opened mids

name: gamut extent
text: gamut extent How far colors are allowed to go toward spectral extremes. wide gamut narrow gamut

name: gate weave
text: gate weave Slow positional jitter of a film gate. locked registration visible weave

name: global contrast
text: global contrast overall contrast Overall separation between lights and darks across the frame. flat low contrast hard high contrast

name: gloss response
text: gloss response Strength and tightness of specular response on surfaces. matte high gloss

name: grain structure
text: grain structure film grain grain size The size, clump, and shape of photochemical-like grain. no grain heavy clumped grain

name: green-magenta tint
text: green-magenta tint Tint axis orthogonal to temperature. green tint magenta tint

name: halation
text: halation highlight bleed red-edge glow film halation A spatial bleed of light, often warm or reddish, around bright sources into adjacent darker areas. clean unbled highlights strong highlight bleed

name: hand-painted surface quality
text: hand-painted surface quality Visible brush, pigment, and irregular paint thickness. factory-smooth finish clearly hand-painted

name: highlight bloom
text: highlight bloom glow highlight glow A general glow around bright regions, broader and less colored than classic halation. tight unbloomed highlights broad highlight glow

text: highlight color bias Hue and chroma lean that appears primarily in highlights. neutral highlights strongly tinted highlights

name: highlight roll-off

name: hue bias
text: hue bias A systematic shift of hues in one direction. no systematic hue lean strong hue lean

name: key-to-fill ratio
text: key-to-fill ratio lighting ratio contrasty lighting The lighting contrast between key and fill, a scene-light property. flat fill hard unfilled key

name: latex or foam feel

name: lens distance feel
text: lens distance feel Apparent camera-to-subject distance, independent of crop. distant close

name: local contrast
text: local contrast Contrast of mid-sized forms, larger than microcontrast and smaller than the whole frame. flat local volumes punched local volumes

name: matte-painting feel
text: matte-painting feel Painted or composited backdrop with a graphic depth plane. photographed space painted plane

name: micro-detail retention

name: microcontrast

name: negative-space bias

name: noise character

name: optical softness

name: palette compression

name: saturation

name: shutter-angle feel

name: skin-tone response

name: source hardness
text: source hardness How hard or soft the key source is, visible in shadow-edge transfer. very soft source hard point source

name: specular intensity
text: specular intensity How bright the specular highlights are, apart from their width. dull speculars hot speculars

text: stylized degradation Intentional damage used as style: scratches, dirt, wear. clean heavily degraded

name: subject scale
text: subject scale How large the subject sits in the frame. small in frame large in frame

name: subsurface feel

name: telecine softness
text: telecine softness old-tv softness film-to-tape softness telecine smear A flat, slightly smeared softness associated with film-to-video transfer, often with reduced fine detail and mild chroma smear. no transfer smear heavy telecine smear

name: temperature

text: temporal smear Display or tape persistence that smears motion in time. no temporal smear heavy temporal smear

name: texture resolution

name: texture uniformity
text: texture uniformity How even the texture field is across the frame. even field uneven clumped field

name: white balance
